name: even if TEMPEST: Tsuranaru Toki no Akatsuki
original_name: even if TEMPEST 連なるときの暁
source:
“Fate‘s final verdict, illuminated by love.”

At the edge of despair, the flower of hope begins to bloom…

When death stole her last breath, the girl reached for the witch’s hand.

She did it to change herself after being deceived and despised. To get revenge on the detestable people that scorned her.

But in the end, what she wished for was neither power nor honor… but love.

[From [url=https://www.gematsu.com/2023/04/even-if-tempest-dawning-connections-launches-this-summer]Gematsu[/url]]
translation:
“命运的最终裁决，被爱照亮。”

在绝望的边缘，希望之花开始绽放……

当死亡夺走了她的最后一口气时，女孩伸手握住了女巫的手。

她这样做是为了在被欺骗和鄙视后改变自己。为了报复那些鄙视她的可憎之人。

但最终，她想要的不是权力，也不是荣誉……而是爱情。

[来自[url=https://www.gematsu.com/2023/04/even-if-tempest-dawning-connections-launches-this-summer]Gematsu[/url]]
